criteria.criterion: Color and value: check for coherent blocks of chassis paint, dark mechanisms and a small visor accent against the playable lineup.
criteria.evidence: The green frontal castings read as a single armor group with one whole pale own-left cheek. Gold is confined to the protected central glazing.

criteria.criterion: Armor construction: broad facets and selective bevels describe the main volumes in the Mech Bay view.
criteria.evidence: The two sloping brows meet a descending center tooth. The outer cheek and the lower shelf make each opening an actual recess.

criteria.criterion: Detail scale: compare at Practice range size. The cockpit, stance and fitted weapon housings remain legible without fine texture.
criteria.evidence: The paired short barrels sit on either side of the center tooth. The large pale cheek and wide boots survive reduction to the Practice reference framing.

criteria.criterion: Joints and interfaces: reinforced load-bearing pivots, protected waist connections and functional weapon attachments share the same industrial construction language.
criteria.evidence: The waist ring and short thigh pins sit below the armor shelf. Protected cannon receivers nest between upper and lower castings.

criteria.criterion: Distinct chassis identity: preserve the requested role, silhouette, cockpit, leg anatomy, proportions and legal mounts; do not copy another reference chassis or blend their equipment.
criteria.evidence: The frontal split shield, asymmetrical paint block, two casemates and broad planted feet give the defensive anchor its own silhouette.

selection.authority: Owner-delegated creative decision by the design agent on 2026-11-24 for the new playable family.
selection.scope: A concept appearance and shared-world family review.
